description: Closed-set discourse-marker lexical variants, sentence/step-initial only.

context_requirements.position: start of sentence or reasoning step only
context_requirements.note: Members within a set substitute ONLY for each other; sets never mix.

exclusions: because/since/as — EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED per freeze (causal discourse relation can move)
'Then' when it carries conditional meaning (preceded by an 'If'-clause in the same sentence) — excluded: if-then is dependency structure, channel 2

'First,' when a 'Second,'/'Next,' has NOT yet appeared and the substitution would break enumeration parallelism established elsewhere in the trace — conservative: exclude 'First,' set entirely whenever the trace contains explicit ordinal enumeration (First/Second/Third)
any marker introducing new hedging (e.g., 'Presumably,') — hedging is channel 2

registered_predictions.fable_depth_interaction: zero on base/light-instruct; positive post outcome-filtered training (high-entropy rule)
